title: 第9章 山神庙里的山神不当值第10章 你这臭娘们就是欠抽
slug: 无敌的女厉鬼有点恋爱脑
lines: 陆远就如同救世主一般突然出现在赵巧儿面前。
这是谁也想不到的，这个之前被武清观众人轻视的小道士，会在这绝望的时刻逆行而回。
对于赵巧儿来说，现在的陆远身上简直都耀着圣光！
特别是在刚刚经历了被抛弃，彻底绝望的赵巧儿来说，现在的陆远在她心中的印象已经无法形容了。
谁也不知道陆远怎么就来了，但陆远就是这么突然出现在赵巧儿面前。
赵巧儿鼻头一酸，泪水在眼眶里打转，几乎要哭出声来。
“好侄儿……你……”
她声音哽咽，一句话都说不完整。
但现在不是叙旧的时候，陆远也没工夫听她哭哭啼啼，语气斩钉截铁，不留半点商量的余地：
“别吵！”
“上来！快！”
赵巧儿不再有任何废话，提起裙摆，那双丰腴修长的雪白大腿在月下划出惊心动魄的弧线。
快步冲到陆远身后，柔软的身子径直趴了上去。
说实话，陆远的个头不算高。
毕竟陆远只是个高中生，还在长身体，也就一米七出头。
可赵巧儿的身段，却是赤足都近一米九的惊人高度。
她还不是那种干瘦的竹竿，而是熟透了的极品蜜桃。
每一寸都散发着惊人的丰腴与性感，是那种细枝上结出了硕果的顶级风情。
赵巧儿那丰腴浮凸的身子这么一趴，陆远感觉自己瞬间被温香软玉彻底包裹。
整个人像是陷进了一团柔软又充满弹性的云朵里。
这一出，活脱脱的小马拉大车。
随着赵巧儿趴上来后，伴随而来的还有赵巧儿那身上独有的熟女雌香。
尽管身形对比悬殊，但陆远可是正儿八经的道士。
每日修行不辍，出活时更是动辄翻山越岭几十里，一身筋骨早已淬炼得远超常人。
赵巧儿趴稳的瞬间，陆远双臂向后一抄，稳稳托住她那两条弧度惊人的丰腴雪白大美腿。
腰背发力，没有丝毫迟滞地将她整个背起。
一旁的王福正要指挥武师上前护卫。
陆远却头也不回地低喝道：
“王管家，不用管我们！”
“这些东西是冲着巧儿姨来的，我带她走，邪祟自然会追过来！”
“你们趁机下山，去镇子里的宗祠躲着！”
王福一怔，下意识看向陆远背上的赵巧儿。
赵巧儿立刻会意，急促地命令道：
“听我这乖侄儿的！”
话音落下，陆远不再磨叽，背着这尊惊人的“玉菩萨”。
双腿猛地发力，如离弦之箭般窜入茫茫夜色。
说实话，就目前这个场景来说。
想要单独把赵巧儿救出去，就算是五星天师来了，那也没陆远好使！
为啥？
content_en:
Lu Yuan suddenly appeared in front of Zhao Qiaoer like a savior.
No one could have imagined that this little Taoist priest who had been despised by the Wuqing audience would turn back at this desperate moment.
For Zhao Qiaoer, Lu Yuan is simply shining with holy light now!
Especially for Zhao Qiaoer, who had just experienced being abandoned and completely despairing, the impression of Lu Yuan in her heart now was beyond description.
No one knew why Lu Yuan came, but Lu Yuan suddenly appeared in front of Zhao Qiaoer.
Zhao Qiaoer's nose felt sore, tears welled up in her eyes, and she almost cried.
"Good nephew...you..."
Her voice was choked and she couldn't finish her sentence.
But now is not the time to reminisce, and Lu Yuan has no time to listen to her crying. His tone is decisive, leaving no room for negotiation:
"Don't make any noise!"
"Come up! Quick!"
Zhao Qiaoer stopped talking nonsense. She lifted up her skirt, and her plump and slender snow-white thighs drew a thrilling arc under the moonlight.
He quickly rushed behind Lu Yuan and lay down directly on his soft body.
To be honest, Lu Yuan is not very tall.
After all, Lu Yuan is only a high school student and is still growing, only about 1.7 meters tall.
But Zhao Qiaoer's figure is astonishingly tall, even with bare feet, nearly 1.9 meters tall.
She is not a skinny bamboo pole, but a ripe peach of the highest quality.
Every inch exudes amazing plumpness and sexiness, the kind of top-notch style that bears fruit on its thin branches.
Zhao Qiao'er's plump and convex body lay down like this, and Lu Yuan felt like he was completely wrapped in warm fragrant nephrite.
The whole figure seemed to be trapped in a soft and elastic cloud.
This time, it looks like a small horse pulling a big cart.
As Zhao Qiaoer lay down, she was accompanied by Zhao Qiaoer's unique mature female fragrance.
Despite the huge difference in stature, Lu Yuan was a serious Taoist priest.
He keeps practicing every day, and often travels dozens of miles over mountains and ridges when he goes out to work. His muscles and bones have been tempered far beyond ordinary people.
The moment Zhao Qiaoer lay down, Lu Yuan moved his arms backwards, firmly supporting her two plump and beautiful white legs with astonishing curvature.
The strength of his waist and back lifted her up without any delay.
Wang Fu on the side was about to command the martial arts master to come forward to protect him.
Lu Yuan, however, shouted in a low voice without looking back:
"Butler Wang, don't worry about us!"
"These things are for Aunt Qiao'er. If I take her away, the evil spirits will naturally come after me!"
"You take the opportunity to go down the mountain and hide in the ancestral hall in the town!"
Wang Fu was startled and subconsciously looked at Zhao Qiaoer on Lu Yuan's back.
Zhao Qiaoer immediately understood and ordered hastily:
"Listen to my good nephew!"
After the words fell, Lu Yuan stopped chattering and carried this amazing "Jade Bodhisattva" on his back.
His legs suddenly exerted force, and they shot into the vast night like an arrow from a string.
To be honest, as far as the current scene is concerned.
If you want to rescue Zhao Qiaoer alone, even if the five-star heavenly master comes, Lu Yuan will not be able to do it!
Why?
